knowledge.purpose: SPLIT body: a selecting list on the left, an answering detail on the right. The selection belongs to the SURFACE, not to this block — the runtime shell carries it and mirrors it into the URL (?selectionKey=itemId), so the selected record is shareable as a link and the browser's Back undoes the selection. Two detail modes: `document` reads top-down; `stream` opens with the newest item at the BOTTOM and the composer as the detail's last child.
useCases: Inbox — subject list + message body (detailMode: document)
Team chat — channel list + message stream + composer (detailMode: stream)
Record management — search results + the selected record's detail
antiPatterns: Adding a footer to the page in stream mode — nothing can sit below the composer
Keeping the selection out of the URL — then the selected record cannot be shared and Back does nothing
Using the list with a single item — with nothing to choose this is not a split, it is one column
knowledge.implementation:
Field mapping: bind items to a source and name its fields with titleKey / bodyKey / metaKey / excerptKey / idKey / entriesKey (dotted paths allowed) — the list and the detail read the record's own fields. Selection: the first row is selected by default; give emptyLabel (or autoSelect:false) and nothing is selected until the visitor picks.

Further anti-patterns:
- Turning the detail pane into a second navigation area — the detail is the answer, not a menu

jsonSchema.description: The rows: {id, title, meta?, excerpt?, body?, entries?}, or any records (a bound source) whose fields the *Key props name.
Field holding the row id (default id, then _id / slug / key). A dotted path reaches a nested field ("data.title").
Field shown as the row title and the detail heading (default title, then name / label). A dotted path reaches a nested field ("data.title").
Field shown under the title (default meta, then subtitle). A dotted path reaches a nested field ("data.title").
Field shown as the one-line excerpt in the list (default excerpt, then summary / description). A dotted path reaches a nested field ("data.title").
Field read as the detail body in document mode (default body, then content / text). A dotted path reaches a nested field ("data.title").
Field holding the stream entries [{from, text, at}] in stream mode (default entries, then messages). A dotted path reaches a nested field ("data.title").
Select the first row while nothing is selected. Unset: on, unless emptyLabel is given — then nothing is selected until the visitor picks, and emptyLabel shows in the detail pane.
document: read from the top like a document. stream: starts at the bottom like a chat, scrolled to the end on open.
Heading of the list column; also the listbox's accessible name.
Name of the URL query parameter carrying the selection. Other blocks reading the same key see the same selection.
Shown in the detail pane while nothing is selected (in the page language, e.g. "Pick a section on the left"). Giving it turns autoSelect off unless autoSelect is set.
Height of the split area (CSS length). The bottom lock of stream mode needs a bounded height.
